title: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Hexylphosphonic acid passivation of CsPbBr3 nanocube surfaces
citation: Synthetic fixture for pipeline testing; not a real publication.
materials: CsPbBr3 nanocubes (~10 nm edge), indexed to the cubic perovskite phase
objective: Explain how hexylphosphonic acid treatment raises the photoluminescence quantum yield of CsPbBr3 nanocubes.
key_findings: XRD indexes the nanocubes to cubic CsPbBr3 with a = 5.87 A.
TEM shows ~10 nm cubes bounded by {100} facets.
After treatment the P-OH band at 950 cm-1 disappears and the P=O band shifts from 1200 to 1100 cm-1.
XPS: the Br/Pb atomic ratio drops from 2.9 to 2.6 and a P 2p peak appears at 133.2 eV.
PL quantum yield increases from 60% to 90%.
author_interpretations: HPA binds as a deprotonated phosphonate to surface Pb, taking the place of surface bromide.
Removing undercoordinated surface Pb sites suppresses non-radiative recombination.
unresolved: Degree of deprotonation (one or two P-OH groups).
